name: Sakuragaoka Risa
source: A top gravure idol and most popular girl in school. She wants to transition from a simple gravure idol to being a proper idol. Because she's so popular and pretty Kohei rapes her using his power to prevent anyone from coming to her aid. Afterwards she can't go to the police because it would ruin her idol career.
